title: Transverse Aortic Constriction in Mice
author: Lin Zhong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6xdhfi6
materials: Mice are anesthetized with pentobarbital (50 mg.kg, IP).

steps.title: Prepare and Disinfect Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Shave and disinfect the ventral neck and left parasternal region using Betadine followed by 70% alcohol.

steps.title: Perform Endotracheal Intubation
steps.instruction: Position the mouse supine on a heating pad and establish mechanical ventilation.

substeps.instruction: Make a small incision through the skin underlying the trachea.
Expose the trachea and make a small puncture.
Perform endotracheal intubation using a PE-50 tube.
Connect the endotracheal tube to a small rodent ventilator (Harvard Apparatus).

steps.title: Expose the Aortic Arch
steps.instruction: Perform a left thoracotomy using a surgical microscope.

substeps.instruction: Enter the second intercostal space using scissors and blunt dissection to expose the aortic arch.

steps.title: Perform Transverse Aortic Constriction
steps.instruction: Constrict the transverse aorta using a needle and ligature.

substeps.instruction: Place a 27G blunt needle parallel to the transverse aorta between the innominate and left common carotid arteries.
Place a 7-0 ligature around the transverse aorta and needle and tie it.
Remove the needle to create a constriction of ~0.4 mm in diameter (for sham mice, perform the procedure identically but omit the ligation).

steps.title: Close the Chest
steps.instruction: Close the chest in layers using 7-0 sutures.

steps.title: Wean from Ventilation and Close Incisions
steps.instruction: Gradually wean the mouse from the ventilator to resolve any possible pneumothorax.

substeps.instruction: Once spontaneous respiration resumes, remove the endotracheal tube.

steps.title: Post-Surgical Recovery and Analgesia
steps.instruction: Maintain the mouse on the heating pad until fully recovered from anesthesia and provide pain management.

substeps.instruction: Administer Buprenorphine SC immediately following surgery.
Administer Buprenorphine SC every 8-12 hr for 72 hr.

steps.title: Verify Stenosis via Echocardiography
steps.instruction: One day following the TAC procedure, subject the mouse to Doppler echocardiography (Vevo2100) to determine the degree of induced stenosis.
